claim_one_line: EPSILON IS THE FRICKE INVARIANT READ MODULO SQUARES -- closing the refinement cell B1192 named and left open ('the general norm-classification'), carried since 2026-08-27 as checklist item I1. THE LAW, symbolic and general: for A,M in SL2 with cq-br != 0 the simultaneous-mirror realizer (XAX^-1 = A^-1, XMX^-1 = M^-1) satisfies IDENTICALLY det X * (cq-br)^2 = 2 - kappa, where kappa = tr[A,M] = x^2+y^2+z^2-xyz-2 is K001/B167's OWN Fricke-Vogt first integral of the trace map (Groebner residue exactly 0 modulo both determinant relations; denominator a perfect square). So det X == 2 - kappa in K*/(K*)^2: the relational bit was never a separate object. INTEGRAL REFINEMENT, CORRECTED IN-SESSION BY A PEER SEAT AND VERIFIED HERE: det(AM - MA) = 2 - kappa identically, and the primitive generator of the rank-1 realizer module is read straight off the ADDITIVE COMMUTATOR with NO LINEAR SOLVE -- det X0 = det((AM - MA)/g) = (2 - kappa)/g^2 with g the entry-gcd of AM - MA. THE FIRST VERSION OF THIS ARC CLAIMED det X0 = squarefree(2 - kappa) AND THAT IS FALSE: against the actual realizer module on 500 random noncommuting partners the peer formula scores 500/500 and squarefree scores 493/500, the sharpest counterexample being 2-kappa = -121 = -(11^2) with entry-gcd 1, where the true det X0 is -121 (TORSOR) while squarefree(-121) = -1 would have called it THE BIT; the two disagree exactly when g^2 is not the largest square dividing 2-kappa, which NONE of the 14 hand-picked partners in the first version exhibited. CORRECTED BIT CRITERION: eps = -1 <=> 2 - kappa = -g^2, NOT 'kappa-2 is a perfect square', verified 500/500. SECOND PEER CATCH, CONFIRMED: one pair does not license a field conclusion -- B1192's sqrt2 control fixed ONE matrix and spoke of the norm class of the FIELD, but both determinant signs occur inside the same trace field Q(sqrt2) (tr = -34: [[-35,-36],[1,1]] gives D = -1 and [[-29,-12],[-12,-5]] gives D = +1), so the exclusion holds for the displayed pair and not the field -- and this arc's first version REPEATED B1192's field-level phrasing. With D = (2-kappa)/g^2 the TRICHOTOMY that reproduces all four behaviours B1192 and B1189 banked as separate empirical facts: D=+1 mirror realized inside SL2(Z) with no bit (sqrt2 control, kappa=-2); D=-1 eps=-1 DIRECT (B1192's crown positive, kappa=3); |D|>1 no GL2(Z) realizer, TORSOR form with det X0 = D (sqrt7 control, kappa=263 -> -29); kappa=2 module rank 2 with both signs (B1189's kill). Verified on 13 partners with the integral realizer recomputed independently of B1192's instrument; all four branches occur (non-vacuity). CONSEQUENCE: B1189's kill is DISSOLVED as a separate fact -- (A,A) has no bit because kappa=2 is Fricke's reducibility locus, forced because A commutes with itself. IDENTIFICATION WITH KNOWN MATHEMATICS, computed here and not cited: the Maclachlan-Reid quaternion algebra of a two-generator group is (A0^2, B1^2) = (tr^2 A - 4, (2-kappa)/(tr^2 A - 4)) ~ (tr^2 A - 4, (2-kappa)(tr^2 A - 4)), verified 267/267 random pairs exact with no floats. CORRECTED IN-SESSION: a first draft wrote the algebra as (tr^2 A - 4, 2 - kappa), identifying eps ITSELF with the second slot -- WRONG, caught by computing 2T, where the Q8 pair (i,j) gives the HURWITZ quaternions (-1,-1) (the known answer) while the wrong form gives (-1,+1), split. eps and the second slot differ by exactly the FIRST slot; det X0 = squarefree(2-kappa) is unaffected and the lock already encoded the correct B1^2 formula. For the object the algebra is (5,-5), split; the draft's (5,-1) is also split, so the conclusion survived while the statement was false. For the object A=[[2,1],[1,1]] the FIRST slot is tr^2 A - 4 = 5 = disc Q(sqrt5). Recorded as REDISCOVERY, not novelty. THE OBJECT'S OWN VALUE: the once-punctured-torus fibre of m004 has parabolic commutator kappa = -2 (discrete faithful rep over Q(sqrt-3)), so 2-kappa = 4 and D = +1 -- the object ALONE carries no bit, and this supplies the MECHANISM for what B1161/B1163/B1183/B1184 held only as an obstruction: the cusp pins kappa below the wall kappa = 2, so the bit can turn on only past it. WHY THIS RAN: the prior crossing probe (prereg 6705d6b2) asked whether a pair supplies a NUMBER, scanned five partners, and returned NO FORCED MAGNITUDE -- a verdict resting on a stop rule that demands the object be a complete theory with zero inputs. It scanned five values of a function and never asked for the function; the owner rejected it on exactly that ground. FENCES: the law is proved for det M = +1 (for det M = -1 there is NO realizer at all, since det M = -1 forces tr M^-1 = -tr M hence tr M = 0); over a field det X is only a square class, the integer invariant existing because the integral module is rank 1; the square class is NOT a bit in general -- a survey of 91 short-word pairs in pi_1(m004) over Q(sqrt-3) found many values (6 trivial, 59 at -1, 26 elsewhere), and an earlier reading of that survey as 'every non-fibre pair is -1' was WRONG and was caught by running it. NOT CLAIMED: no crossing to physics, no measured value, no prediction. Gate 5 clean.
note: THE PROBE WAS BAD AND THE OWNER CALLED IT. The prior verdict ('NO FORCED MAGNITUDE') came from scanning five values of a function without ever computing the function. One symbolic solve turned a menu into an identity, and the identity landed on the programme's OWN conserved quantity. Three self-caught errors are recorded in the arc rather than smoothed away: (1) a wrong partner matrix ([[1,2],[1,1]], det -1) produced a spurious mismatch against B1192's sqrt2 control -- fixed by reading the matrix out of B1192's own data instead of inferring it; (2) the Maclachlan-Reid check first reported 267 mismatches that were a uniform sign flip; (3) a 91-pair survey was briefly read as 'every non-fibre pair is -1', which running it refuted. The general lesson for the crossing programme: a crossing is a LAW the object forces among quantities, not a number it emits -- every banked success (sin^2 theta_W = 3/8, I = -1, lambda = 1, the hierarchy ratios) is partner-independent RELATION, and the old stop rule was measuring for the wrong kind of object. CORRECTED AGAIN, same session, by a PEER SEAT: the integral refinement det X0 = squarefree(2-kappa) was FALSE (493/500 against the realizer; the additive-commutator formula det((AM-MA)/g) scores 500/500), and the arc had also repeated B1192's field-level phrasing of the sqrt2 control when both signs occur in that same field. Both catches came from outside this seat and both were verified here before adoption. The pattern across all of them is one thing: a claim checked only on the examples that suggested it.
